topics.label: Lecture Welcome and Introduction
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the opening framing, welcoming students and outlining the lecture's focus on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Innate Immune Recognition and Pattern Recognition Receptors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the innate immune system detects infections and tissue damage through molecular patterns and pattern recognition receptor pathways.

topics.label: Inflammatory Cell Activation, Trafficking, and Systemic Consequences
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail how sentinel cells initiate the inflammatory response, coordinate leukocyte recruitment into tissues, prime adaptive immunity via lymphatics, and trigger systemic effects such as septic shock.

topics.label: Resolution of Inflammation, Tissue Repair, and Chronic Pathology
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the mechanisms that terminate inflammation, guide tissue repair, and sustain chronic inflammatory states such as granulomas.

topics.label: Lecture Closing
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding framing, wrapping up the session and noting the topic of the next lecture.
